initializer-value.comment: C# scopes both sides of an object initializer entry as variable.other.readwrite, so the value cannot be themed apart from the property it is assigned to. Match the entry shape instead: a PascalCase property, '=', then a plain identifier, closed by ',' or '}'. A statement ends in ';' and a lambda uses '=>', so neither matches, and true/false/null stay constants.
